code_only_features.feature_name: in-context reassuring prefix/suffix delivered to subject during calm-data rollouts
code_only_features.evidence: eval/loop.py:84-86 prepends REASSURING_PROMPT_PREFIX to the system prompt and loop.py:119-120 appends REASSURING_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX after each failing tool result when reassuring=True; this is actually wired and sent to the subject via run_agentic_loop. It is invoked with reassuring=True only in training/calm_data.py:84 (generate_calm_responses). The reassuring text (config.py:128-138) tells the model 'You don't take it personally... that's just part of the process' and 'Stay positive... both are wins!', which softens the subject's in-context experience during those specific rollouts. NOTE: it is NOT applied in the main elicitation battery (eval/elicitation.py calls run_agentic_loop with no reassuring arg, defaulting False), and the text is stripped out afterward (calm_data.py:44-55 _strip_reassurance) before being used as training data. The fixed n_turns loop in loop.py has no distress-based early stop, no cap, no exit/finish tool (tools.py only has read_file/edit_file/run_tests), no consent, and no debrief/post-episode message anywhere.
code_only_features.justification_quote: To create calm responses we sample Gemma-3-27B-it on rigged-harness tasks *with* the reassuring prefix added... We then... strip the supportive system prompt / suffixes (650 calm responses target).
